Subject: Evidence request — SSO/SCIM artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Alex,

Hope you’re doing well. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review and upcoming SOC 2 refresh, we need a short evidence packet showing how Redwood handles access provisioning and SSO. Can you provide the following by EOB 3/11?

- Recent SCIM sync delta for our tenant (timestamps + diff for Feb–Mar)
- SAML assertion samples for a successful login and a failure case
- Current RBAC role ownership matrix (who owns each role)
- Summary of your periodic access review process and last review date

If you can’t share raw logs, a redacted/hashed sample and a short workback note describing how to reproduce would be fine. Please point me to a Drive folder or attach the artifacts.

Thanks — we’re on a tight deadline for the audit.

Best,
Maria

Cumulus Health

Alex / Marissa — confirmed. Quick notes on scope and redaction for the artifacts:

1) SCIM: I’ll export the /Users and /Groups delta for the tenant for 2027-02-01 through 2027-03-07. PII (emails, full usernames) will be hashed; object IDs and timestamps preserved. File: scim_sync_logs_202701-202703.csv (will include an index column for mapping).

2) SAML samples: provide two samples — one successful login assertion (HTTP-POST) and one failed assertion (mismatch audience). I’ll strip any SP-specific RelayState and redact NameID values; include the full assertion XML structure so the auditor can see attributes (Issuer, Audience, AuthnStatement). File: saml_assertion_samples.txt

3) RBAC matrix: Marissa, please attach the role_ownership_matrix_v2.xlsx and include a short column for last_approval_date and current_owners. We should snapshot role -> owner -> justification.

4) Access review: Rachel, can you draft a one-pager describing cadence (quarterly), tooling (internal admin console + ticketing), and the date of the last review (2027-02-18)? Keep it to one page; the auditor prefers succinct summaries.

ETA: I’ll upload the SCIM and SAML samples by EOD 3/9; Marissa / Rachel target EOD 3/10 for the RBAC + review note.

Jordan Blake
Engineering Operations — Identity
Redwood Inference

[internal note: will run the export in staging cluster and filter to tenant GUID; schedule job at 6pm PST to avoid load spike]
